title: 第15章 吃嘴子的体验是怎么样的第16章 师兄嫁给我之后太清宗的宗主之位就是你的
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“师姐，你怎么来了？”
说完这话，犹如八爪鱼一般盘踞在他身上的小徒弟将手给放开，主动结束了这一刺激的贴贴。
显然，被对她很好的师姐看到自己偷吃对她而言也有些羞耻！
“因为师尊进来已经很久了，我担心他对你......这才！”
“但是我怎么都没有想到，小师妹你居然会做这样的事情！”
说完，李鸾凤的眼眸里蕴藏着无尽的怒意。
也就是做出这种事的人是小师妹，不然她现在已经提刀开始绞杀狐狸精了！
‘我亲不到的嘴子，师妹为什么能亲到？’
‘难道师尊喜欢师妹胜过我百倍千倍？我这辈子还有机会吃到师尊的嘴子嘛？’
‘要不，我也把师尊关在地下室好了，这样给不给我亲，应该就由不得师尊了！’
这般思考着，少女身上缠绕的火焰顿时变得更加澄澈明艳，就仿佛是想通了此前困扰许久的修炼问题一般。
“鸾凤，你是不是在想一些不好的事情？”
身子骨莫名感觉到一股阴冷，江尘羽用询问的目光看着自己的二徒弟。
不知为何，他觉得二徒弟目光中崇敬与憧憬少了许多，看向他的眼神中也充斥着一股难言的侵略性。
“没有，师尊，您多虑了！”
李鸾凤摆了摆手，身上外放的火焰顿时就收敛回了体内，眼神也变得平静且毫无波澜。
“没有就好！”
“从今往后你师妹就不在地下室待了，我将会把她带到外边的世界！”
“现在她还什么都没有，你作为师姐的，照顾一下你师妹也是应该的。
所以像是衣物以及生活用品之类的，就让你带她一起采购吧！”

说完这话，江尘羽抚了下衣袖，随后身形迅速地消散在了两位徒弟的眼前。
不得不说，被二徒弟撞见自己被小徒弟吃嘴子的事情还是有些太过尴尬了！
哪怕是他这种资深的黄油玩家，也难免被一股莫名其妙地羞耻感所侵蚀。
空荡荡的地下室中，只剩下了李鸾凤以及林诗钰两人。
“师妹，你刚刚亲过师尊了是吧？”
发丝仿若炽热的火焰般赤红的少女踱着步子，来到了那位身上只穿着一件单薄素裙的小萝莉身旁。
“师姐，你想干什么，师尊他还没走远呢？”
察觉到善良的师姐有朝着黑化的边缘迈进的趋势，少女弱弱地提醒了一句。
她比谁都清楚，这位二师姐对师尊到底痴迷到一种什么地步。
从古至今，能够以男人的身份成为大乘境强者的人只有寥寥三两位。
但就在她与二师姐见面的第一天，她那位二师姐便坚定地相信自家师尊能够成为渡劫境强者，并且还不仅仅只是普通的渡劫境。
而是横贯古今的最强渡劫境仙人！
“放心吧，师妹，我是不会伤害你的！”
察觉到小师妹眼眸中的一抹恐慌，李鸾凤的眼皮跳了下，随后歉意地看了她一眼。
显然，女子也知道自己刚刚的眼神可能会有些恐怖。
“我只不过想问一下师妹，师尊的嘴子亲起来到底是什么感觉而已！”
“什么感觉嘛？这个感觉不是很好描述！”
“但是，还挺舒服的！”
说完这话之后，林诗钰双手不断摩挲着衣袖，显然也是有些娇羞了！
“是吗？那能让我也体验一下嘛！”

少女露出了和煦的笑容。
content_en:
"Sister, why are you here?"
After saying this, the little apprentice, who was sitting on his body like an octopus, let go of his hand and took the initiative to end this exciting sex.
Obviously, it was a bit embarrassing for her to be seen eating secretly by her senior sister who was very kind to her!
"Because it's been a long time since Master came in, and I'm worried that he's treating you... like this!"
"But I never thought that little junior sister you would actually do such a thing!"
After speaking, Li Luanfeng's eyes contained endless anger.
That is to say, the person who did such a thing is the junior sister, otherwise she would have picked up the knife and started to strangle the vixen!
‘Why can my junior sister kiss my mouth that I can’t kiss? ’
‘Does Master like Junior Sister a hundred times more than me? Will I still have the chance to eat Master's mouth in this life? ’
‘Otherwise, I should lock Master in the basement. Then it’s not up to Master whether you kiss me or not! ’
Thinking like this, the flames wrapped around the girl's body suddenly became clearer and brighter, as if she had figured out the cultivation problem that had been bothering her for a long time.
"Luanfeng, are you thinking about something bad?"
Feeling an inexplicable coldness in his body, Jiang Chenyu looked at his second disciple with questioning eyes.
For some reason, he felt that the reverence and admiration in the eyes of the second disciple were much less, and the eyes looking at him were filled with an unspeakable aggression.
"No, Master, you are worrying too much!"
Li Luanfeng waved his hand, and the flames emanating from his body immediately returned to his body, and his eyes became calm and unruffled.
"It's better if you don't have it!"
"From now on, your junior sister will no longer stay in the basement. I will take her to the outside world!"
"She doesn't have anything right now. As a senior sister, you should take care of your junior sister.
So for things like clothing and daily necessities, let you take her to buy them together! "
After saying this, Jiang Chenyu stroked his sleeves, and then quickly disappeared in front of the two disciples.
I have to say that it was a bit too embarrassing for my second apprentice to catch me being eaten by my younger apprentice!
Even a veteran butter player like him would inevitably be eroded by an inexplicable sense of shame.
In the empty basement, only Li Luanfeng and Lin Shiyu were left.
"Junior sister, you just kissed Master, right?"
The girl with hair as red as a blazing flame walked up to the little loli who was only wearing a thin plain skirt.
"Senior sister, what do you want to do? Master hasn't gone far yet?"
Sensing that her kind-hearted senior sister was heading towards the edge of darkness, the girl gave a weak reminder.
She knew better than anyone how obsessed this second senior sister was with her master.
From ancient times to the present, there have only been a handful of men who can become powerful men in the Mahayana realm.
But on the first day she met her second senior sister, her second senior sister firmly believed that her master could become a strong person in the tribulation realm, and not just an ordinary tribulation realm.
Rather, he is the most powerful immortal who has transcended the tribulation realm throughout ancient and modern times!
"Don't worry, junior sister, I won't hurt you!"
Sensing a hint of panic in the junior sister's eyes, Li Luanfeng's eyelids twitched, and then he looked at her apologetically.
Obviously, the woman also knew that the look in her eyes just now might be a bit scary.
"I just want to ask my junior sister what it feels like to kiss Master on the mouth!"
"What does it feel like? This feeling is not easy to describe!"
"But it's quite comfortable!"
After saying this, Lin Shiyu kept rubbing her sleeves with her hands, obviously feeling a little shy!
"Really? Then let me experience it too!"
The girl showed a warm smile.
